_README: Merge these two keys into ~/.claude/settings.json. Do not replace the whole file - it already has your other settings. Replace CLAUDE_EPAPER_PATH with the absolute path to your clone, e.g. C:/code/claude-code-epaper or /home/you/claude-code-epaper. Forward slashes work on Windows too.
_OPTIONAL_PreToolUse: Adding PreToolUse shows which tool is running ('running Bash') but spawns node before EVERY tool call, adding roughly 100ms each. Only add it if you want that detail: "PreToolUse": [{"matcher": "*", "hooks": [{"type": "command", "command": "node \"CLAUDE_EPAPER_PATH/bridge/bridge.js\" hook PreToolUse", "timeout": 5}]}]
